title: Voting — Election Register — payload
description: A community registers an election it signed with the ballot box the election's manifest names. The ballot box answers with its view of the election.

community.description: The community's DID. Equal to the proven signer and to `manifest.community`.

manifestDigest.description: The SHA-256 multihash of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization of `manifest`, as the community computed it.

parameters.description: The community's voting parameters: the key the election's tickets are issued under, which every cast's attestation is checked against.
